releases.title: Closer on the phone
releases.alt: Yooba on a plank bridge inside the glass fence, with a goal message on screen.
notes: The title screen and launch text no longer appear on top of the consent dialog.
At the largest size, the camera sits closer so Yooba is easier to see on a phone.
Yooba Town stutters less during play.

releases.title: Brighter buildings
releases.alt: Yooba Town market stalls with crates of apples, pumpkins and watermelons.
notes: Buildings have cleaner, brighter colours and their surfaces look neater from every angle.

releases.title: Licorice Reach
releases.alt: The eight orbs of the Road Home, ending at the Dark Bell in Licorice Reach.
notes: Licorice Reach is a new area to explore, with its own scenery and music.
The first trip to the Yooba Town waystone is much quicker, with no long black screen.
Players who have stepped away online now appear faded, and hosting passes to another player when the host leaves.
The Dark Bell dais can be reached, and the Eighth Orb ring and closing card now play through to the end.

releases.title: Under the hood
releases.alt: Yooba Town under a bright sky on the Road Home.
notes: Small fixes under the hood so the walk keeps moving.

releases.title: The Gust, on camera
releases.alt: A windy night sky over Yooba Land, the Gust that carried Yooba here.
notes: A new video shows where Yooba came from in The Gust.
The camera now keeps Yooba in view when he has grown to his biggest size.
At his largest size, the camera no longer drops in tight behind him and loses the view.
During the orb-eating cutscene, the camera stays on Yooba while he speaks instead of cutting to a building.

releases.title: A quieter patch
releases.alt: Trees and bushes on bright grass inside the glass fence, with a red orb in the air.
notes: Small fixes so the orchard, the bridge and the walk feel steadier.

releases.title: Smoother camera, goals and labels
releases.alt: Yooba beside a wooden path and a glass wall.
notes: The camera no longer slips through glass, windows, or trees as you move around.
The screen no longer goes black when the camera is set to its larger size.
The Eat the orb goal now completes when Yooba is on the walkway beside the glass fence.
The waypoint label no longer overlaps the text in the goal panel.

releases.title: Roads, boats and the plane
releases.alt: A wooden bridge over water inside the glass fence, on the way out into the world.
notes: The world now loads in as you move through it, so going from place to place means less waiting.
The footsteps are gone, so walking around Yooba Land is much quieter.
Cars drive the roads, boats float on the coast and lake, and the plane can take off from Skyport, fly over the world, and land again.
If the game went dark after the credits, it now brings the world back so you can keep playing.

releases.title: The walk home starts here
releases.alt: The Glass Garden where Yooba lands from The Gust.
notes: I am small. I am hungry. Home is that way.
Apples first. Watermelons and pumpkins once I am big enough.
Every bite makes me bigger.
Past the broken glass there is a whole town. Old Reed says sit still; Bramley gave me a golden seed.
I am not the only Yooba. Past the glass we walk together.
